omar: Quick flag: PR #5622 has the /rerank examples using `items` (array of strings) in curl/python, but the OpenAPI and SDK expect `inputs` (array of objects with id+text). Also response example uses `scores` as list of floats but runtime returns objects [{"id":..., "score":...}]. CI snippet validator is failing.

kelly: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5622 — thanks for catching. Which files are out of sync?

omar: api-ref/rerank.yaml example, guides/rerank.md snippets, and quickstart-rust.md (Rust SDK snippet) all show legacy shapes. The failing curl example is:

````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/rerank -d '{"model":"rerank-v1","items":["a","b","c"]}'
````
Should be canonical:

````
{"model":"rerank-v1","inputs":[{"id":"a","text":"..."},{"id":"b","text":"..."}]}
````
and response example:

````
{"data":[{"id":"a","score":0.93},{"id":"b","score":0.42}],"model":"rerank-v1"}
````
(not plain array of floats).

raj: I can push a fix for the YAML and the Python/Rust snippets. For Rust I'll switch from `items: Vec<&str>` to `inputs: Vec<InputItem>` and show a small struct example.

kelly: Also add a short YAML comment in api-ref/rerank.yaml clarifying stable field names: inputs -> canonical; items kept only for legacy compat. That will help external contributors.

omar: One more nuance: our Kotlin snippet used `scores: [0.9, 0.8]` and downstream SDK mapping expects objects. Tests parse examples and fail if response shapes don't match client expectations. Please update Kotlin + Node examples.

raj: Will do. Plan: update examples, add CHANGELOG line in docs/changes.md referencing snip-113, and add a snippet-linter rule that rejects response examples where list items are primitives when schema requires objects.

ci-bot: docs-snippet-lint started for branch fix/rerank-examples (triggered by raj)

kelly: Also note: the OpenAPI `example` block currently sets `limit` as a string \"10\" in one place. Convert to number. We should add a small unit test to catch quoted numerics in both request and response examples.

raj: Patch pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcd9876 — updated api-ref/rerank.yaml, guides/rerank.md, quickstart-rust.md, and examples in quickstart-kotlin.md. Added snip-113 linter test and CHANGELOG entry.

ci-bot: build-docs #1601 started for branch fix/rerank-examples

omar: Ran snippet-runner locally against that commit: Rust/Kotlin/Node/Python all pass now. Left one minor comment about ordering fields in examples (model, inputs, limit).

docs-bot: build-docs #1601 succeeded for branch fix/rerank-examples

kelly: Merged. Thanks @raj and @omar — good catch. If we keep seeing these legacy keys show up, let's add a short lint rule during PRs to scan for `\"items\"` and `\"scores\"` usage in examples and flag them with suggested replacements.

omar: Agreed. Opening a follow-up issue to add an automated normalization step and update CONTRIBUTING.md with canonical shapes guidance. Closing thread.
